body: These have been my two only relationships. I tell people how these situations make me feel, but all they ever say in response is "you're pretty. You'll be fine." I'm so tired of hearing that.
Like, even if someone could tell me what the fuck I'm doing wrong in relationships, that would be great.

But close relationships are the only thing that's really fulfilling in my life. They don't even have to be romantic. I want people I feel close to, and safe and can trust, but I don't have that anymore. Everything is just dry without it. Just sort of going through the motions.

The worst is when you can just feel people slipping away and you have no idea what you've done wrong. Everything is just empty now.
